events.factual_description: Jazz at Lincoln Center lists the Robert Hurst Quartet featuring Gary Bartz, Orrin Evans and Jeff 'Tain' Watts at Dizzy's Club from January 7 through January 10, 2027. The official ticketing page lists performances at 19:00 on January 7; 19:00 and 21:00 on January 8 and 9; and 17:00 and 19:30 on January 10. Standard face-value covers are $50 plus a $5 fee, student reservation charges are $25 plus a $5 fee, and the club requires a $25 per-person food-and-beverage minimum.

en.why_it_matters: The event's value is the exact rhythm-and-harmony conversation, not the accumulation of famous names: Hurst and Watts bring a deeply developed bass-and-drums language, Evans can redirect form and harmony from inside the quartet, and Bartz adds a living bridge from Miles Davis-era electric exploration to his own post-bop and groove vocabulary. Dizzy's small room makes that interaction unusually legible.
en.trip_verdict: Actively prioritize one set if New York is reachable in January. This lineup merits making room, while seven performances across four nights make A+ more accurate than treating any single set as scarce enough for S.

es.why_it_matters: El valor está en la conversación rítmica y armónica de esta formación exacta, no en sumar nombres famosos: Hurst y Watts aportan un lenguaje de bajo y batería profundamente desarrollado, Evans puede redirigir forma y armonía desde dentro del cuarteto, y Bartz enlaza en vida la exploración eléctrica de la era de Miles Davis con su propio vocabulario de post-bop y groove. La escala íntima de Dizzy's vuelve especialmente audible esa interacción.
es.trip_verdict: Priorizaría activamente uno de los sets si Nueva York queda al alcance en enero. La formación merece hacerle espacio; siete funciones en cuatro noches hacen que A+ sea más preciso que tratar una sola función como suficientemente escasa para S.
